description: Adversaries may attempt to access detailed information about the password policy used within an enterprise network or cloud environment. Password policies are a way to enforce complex passwords that are difficult to guess or crack through brute force.
artifacts: LDAP queries (TCP/389, TCP/636) for domain password policy attributes
LDAP search requests targeting rootDSE or domain object for password complexity, length, and lockout attributes
SMB protocol negotiation packets (TCP/445) associated with password policy queries
RPC endpoint mapper connections (TCP/135) for password policy enumeration
RPC calls to SAMR protocol (SamrQueryInformationDomain) for password policy retrieval
Domain controller responses containing minPwdLength, pwdProperties, lockoutThreshold attributes
Net accounts command traffic over RPC to the domain controller
